privacyPolicyBody:
BugPilot AI uses Firebase Authentication for your account. Your email and profile name are used for account management. Your password is not stored in the app database.

Reports and profile photos are stored on this device. Account report databases are encrypted. Screenshots remain in app-private files. Reports and photos do not sync between devices.

With your permission, AI analysis sends report text, logs and enabled screenshots to OpenAI. Duplicate checks also send relevant existing report text. Remove credentials, access keys and private third-party information before submitting. OpenAI processes data under its service policies. The app requests that responses not be stored, but this does not imply removal of all service logs.

You can withdraw AI permission here; this does not recall data already sent. You can delete individual reports or delete your account and associated data on this device from the Account and data panel. Uninstalling the app may remove device data.

This version has no ads or purchases. A published privacy policy and developer contact information must be added before store release.
aiConsentDescription: Analysis sends report text and logs to OpenAI. When enabled, screenshot analysis also sends your selected image and duplicate checks send relevant existing reports. Remove passwords, keys and private information first. Allow sharing for AI requests in this session? You can withdraw permission in Privacy and data use.
verifyEmailBeforeAi: Verify your email before using AI. You can request a verification email and refresh your account in Your profile.
